reports.title: PTC Announces Fourth fiscal Quarter and Full Fiscal YEar 2026 Results

desk.headline: Revenue down 25% to $673m on contract timing, but recurring base up 8%; adjusted EPS $2.03 vs $1.59 estimate; guidance dropped ahead of Schneider Electric takeover
results: Quarterly revenue fell 25% to $673m because accounting rules book much of a multi-year licence up front, and fewer big renewals fell in this quarter.
Annual run rate (ARR), the better guide to the subscription base, rose 8% to $2.51bn, excluding the Kepware and ThingWorx units sold earlier in the year.
Adjusted EPS fell to $2.03 from $3.41; GAAP EPS was $1.44 versus $2.88.
For the full year revenue was flat at $2.73bn, adjusted EPS rose 4% to $8.24 and free cash flow was $873m.
PTC bought back $1.62bn of shares in the year, while debt rose to $1.61bn from $1.20bn.

guidance.summary: PTC has agreed to be bought by Schneider Electric (announced 5 Oct 2026). Because of the pending deal it no longer gives quarterly or annual guidance and has stopped holding earnings calls.

call.source: No call coverage found — PTC held no call; it suspended earnings calls pending the Schneider Electric deal

watch: Progress and approvals for the Schneider Electric takeover.
ARR growth as the cleanest read on the business while no guidance is given.
